Job Search CRM.context: My own job-search platform, deployed on a cloud VM and used daily in my real job search
notes: I have been looking for a job for more than two years in a tough market, and new government rule changes kept forcing me to adapt, sometimes several times within a few days. It felt overwhelming.
I wanted something that would ease the search. When I looked for tools, most were fake, unfinished, unproductive or simply failed.
So I built it myself, aiming to solve most of those problems while keeping it mostly free for people who need it.

notes: I built it to learn: to take my skills to the next level and understand how the whole system fits together, not just one piece.
